20261122-chemistry-g02-2.s.s1.prompt: [E2 Binciken Kemistri (Babba)] Matsalar bincike mai yawa game da Foda da Haɗuwa. Ruwan acid $A$ yana da $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kuma ruwa $B$ yana da $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Sau nawa karfin ion hydrogen na $A$ ya fi na $B$ girma?
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.s.s1.explain:
Mataki 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Mataki 2: Rabo $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Mataki 3: Karfin $A$ ya ninka na $B$ sau 100.
